system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global coastline vector dataset covering all continents and most islands larger than 100 m², excluding Antarctica and remote polar islands.

data_description.temporal_unit: Single reference year encoded in feature attributes
data_description.data_type_numeric: Attribute schema is mixed; inspect property fields before numeric aggregation

property_semantics_hint.Location: Tile or grid identifier attached to the coastline segment in the sampled feature.
property_semantics_hint.Source: Source label for the extracted coastline geometry in the sampled feature.
property_semantics_hint.Time: Reference year attached to the sampled coastline segment.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine FeatureCollection probe. The prompt preserves the observed feature count, geometry type, and sampled attributes, and treats `Time` as the authoritative reference year for this shoreline release.
analytical_capabilities: Combination with storm surge, settlement, or mangrove layers

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Vector shoreline geometry; no single canonical numeric unit is exposed in the sampled attributes.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use feature length, segment count, or joins with external coastal layers depending on the downstream analysis.

data_description.data_source: Yuanqiang Duan, Arturo Sanchez-Azofeifa, Chunpeng Chen, Bo Tian, Xing Li, Dhritiraj Sengupta, Yunxuan Zhou via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
